Aisha N: quick update from the dev cluster run - I combined the spectral early-stop heuristic with q8 quant on the new 13B draft model. short summary: latency wins, quality mixed.
Tom K: mixed in what dimensions? numbers?
Aisha N: p50 latency for short prompts (<=64 tok) improved ~18%. throughput ~22% in microbench. however, SummEval rouge-L down ~1.8, rouge-1 ~1.1. DialogueBench conv-coherence down ~1.5%.
Maya P: those are not huge but not negligible. are logprobs shifted? sampling config same?
Aisha N: token logprobs look similar across runs. all experiments used seed=42, temp=0.7, top_p=0.92. command I launched: 
```
runtest --model draft-13b-q8 --spec-earlystop=0.7 --seed=42 --batch=8 --dataset=summ-eval,dialoguebench
```
Diego R: could be an interaction: q8 reduces representation fidelity and early-stop threshold misfires on low-entropy but semantically important tokens. did you try a float16 baseline?
Aisha N: baseline float16 run queued, plus a q8-only (no earlystop) run. also spinning a spec-earlystop=0.9 run now.
ops-bot: Deploy queued: experiment-queue/1765439998 started on eng-ml-dev-03 (slot id 1223).
Tom K: if 0.9 reduces regression, it's threshold sensitivity. if not, it's quantization introducing structural changes.
Aisha N: early numbers for 0.9: latency uplift falls to ~9% (still decent). SummEval regression shrinks to ~0.6 rouge-L. seems threshold-sensitive.
Maya P: I skimmed generated outputs. two recurring failure modes: 1) polite/closure tokens trigger early-stop -> premature truncation, harming coherence. 2) occasional phrase repeats in argumentative docs.
Diego R: spectral energy heuristics can undercount syntactic glue tokens. suggestion: add min-output-length and an ngram safety check to disable earlystop when trigram-repeat > 1.
Aisha N: good call. implementing two mitigations: min_len=12 and trigram-guard. testing now.
Tom K: also capture a 200-case subset where quality delta is concentrated so we can run human spot-checks and plot deltas. can you dump that once the runs finish?
Aisha N: yep - collecting a failure subset and will hand to Tom/Maya for labeling.
Maya P: if trigram-guard fixes most, we can gate it behind a feature flag as safe-mode default.
Diego R: additionally, please produce per-token calibration plots (logprob vs token position) and prefix-entropy traces for the failing cases. could reveal systematic miscalibration.
Aisha N: adding to action items. current plan: finish float16, q8-only, spec0.9, and minlen+trigram experiments. assemble 200-case triage set. produce calibration + token-energy traces.
Tom K: timeline?
Aisha N: expecting full set in ~1.5 hrs. will post a consolidated thread with plots and example pairs. tagging @Tom K @Maya P for follow-up. :mag:
Tom K: thanks - nice iterative approach. :thumbsup:
